tvShow.name: Lucky
tvShow.overview: When a multi-million-dollar heist goes sideways, con artist Lucky is forced to go on the run. Pursued by both the FBI and a ruthless crime boss, Lucky must fight for her life—and a way out.

episodes.name: No Shortcuts
episodes.overview: After a wild night in Vegas, Lucky wakes up to discover her world has been turned upside down.

episodes.name: Make 'em Dance
episodes.overview: Seeking shelter, Lucky takes refuge with an unsuspecting family. Priscilla visits Lucky's father.

episodes.name: Read the Room
episodes.overview: Lucky tries to track down Cary—and her money. Agent Rand investigates Lucky's moves.

episodes.name: Too Close to See It
episodes.overview: As Lucky confronts betrayal, old grudges take a back seat to a deadly chase.

episodes.name: Are We Bad People?
episodes.overview: On the run again, Lucky makes a lucrative discovery. Agent Rand devises a plan.

episodes.name: Wherever You Go, There You Are
episodes.overview: Lucky must face her past while planning for her future.

episodes.name: All Good Things
episodes.overview: Everything is on the line as Lucky navigates an explosive confrontation.

seasons.name: Miniseries
seasons.overview: A reformed criminal is forced to confront her past and return to illicit activities for one final job, hoping to secure her freedom and leave her former life behind for good.

reviews.author: Rexorexor
reviews.content: Not the best show, but its worth it if you have nothing else to watch. Nothing too compelling yet. Typical "avoid the cops, avoid the gangsters after me at the same time" type thing.
